mentions.name: Patched SDCC build
mentions.description: This is a patched build of the SDCC compiler with fixes for its miscompiles and performance issues, assembled from knowledge of the full downloaded issue tracker plus fuzzing; it is used to compile the author's Game Gear test ROMs.
mentions.problem: SDCC is full of miscompiles and performance issues that kept causing problems while making the ROMs.
mentions.source_excerpt: SDCC is the compiler I'm using for the ROMs and it's full of miscompiles and performance issues, so I'm running a patched build with everything I know about fixed, because I kept running into stupid issues while making the aforementioned ROMS (downloaded the whooole issue tracker and even fuzzed it a bit).
mentions.author: MrMetric
